_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Tú Imreoir {player_id} i Tic Tac Toe trí Imreoir.
Is é do shiombail '{symbol}'.
Glacann tú sealanna ag cur do shiombail ar chlár 5x5 chun líne de cheathair a chruthú.
Is féidir línte a bheith cothrománach, ingearach, nó déanach.
Cuir isteach do ghluaisne sa chéadfhormáid '[4]' chun ceall 4 a mharcáil.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Formáid bhogadh neamhbhailí. Úsáid '[cell]' áit a bhfuil 'cell' 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Uimhir chill neamhbhailí: {cell}. Ní mór go mbeadh sé idir 0 agus {max_cell} .
invalid_move.already_occupied: Tá cealla {cell} á n-úsáid cheana féin.

game_action.placed: Cuireann Imreoir {player_id} a shiombail ({symbol}) i gcéim ({row}, {col}).
